theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  have h_main : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ u i = u j ∧ u (i+1) = u (j+1) ∧ u (i+2) = u (j+2) ∧ u (i+3) = u (j+3) := by
    obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
    classical
    let f : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ × ℤ × ℤ := fun n => (u n, u (n+1), u (n+2), u (n+3))
    have h_finite : Set.Finite (Set.range f) := by
      have h_sub : Set.range f ⊆ Set.Icc (B,B,B,B) (T,T,T,T) := by
        intro x hx; rcases hx with ⟨n, rfl⟩
        simp only [mem_Icc, Prod.le_def]
        constructor <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try constructor) <;>
        (try simp_all [f, and_self])
      have h_finite_Icc : Set.Finite (Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)) := by
        apply Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.mem_finset (Finset.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T)))
        intro x hx
        simp_all only [ge_iff_le, ne_eq, mem_Icc, Finset.mem_Icc, mem_setOf_eq, and_self]
      exact Set.Finite.subset h_finite_Icc h_sub
    have h_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective f := by
      intro h_inj
      have h_inf := Set.infinite_range_of_injective h_inj
      exact Set.not_infinite.mpr h_finite h_inf
    have h_exists_distinct_eq : ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y := by
      by_contra! h
      have h_inj : Function.Injective f := by
        intro x y hxy
        by_cases hxy' : x = y
        · exact hxy'
        · have hne : x ≠ y := hxy'
          have h_eq : f x = f y := hxy
          have h_contra := h x y hne h_eq
          contradiction
      exact h_not_injective h_inj
    obtain ⟨x, y, hne, h_eq⟩ := h_exists_distinct_eq
    have h_lt : x < y ∨ y < x := lt_or_gt_of_ne hne
    obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := by
      cases h_lt with
      | inl hij => exact ⟨x, y, hij, h_eq⟩
      | inr hij => exact ⟨y, x, hij, by simpa using h_eq⟩
    refine' ⟨i, j, hij, _⟩
    simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at h_eq
    exact h_eq
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ := h_main
  have h_periodic : ∀ m, u (i+m) = u (j+m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      match m with
      | 0 => exact h_eq.1
      | 1 => exact h_eq.2.1
      | 2 => exact h_eq.2.2.1
      | 3 => exact h_eq.2.2.2
      | k+4 =>
        have h_i := hu (i+k+4) (by omega)
        have h_j := hu (j+k+4) (by omega)
        have h_eq_i : (u (i+k+4) : ℝ) = ((u (i+k+3) + u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) * u (i+k)) : ℝ) / (u (i+k+3) * u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) + u (i+k)) := by
          norm_cast at h_i ⊢; exact h_i.1
        have h_eq_j : (u (j+k+4) : ℝ) = ((u (j+k+3) + u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) * u (j+k)) : ℝ) / (u (j+k+3) * u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) + u (j+k)) := by
          norm_cast at h_j ⊢; exact h_j.1
        have h_rhs_eq_int : (u (i+k+3) + u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) * u (i+k)) =
                           (u (j+k+3) + u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) * u (j+k)) := by
          rw [ih (k+3) (by omega), ih (k+2) (by omega), ih (k+1) (by omega), ih k (by omega)]
          rfl
        have h_rhs_eq_denom_int : (u (i+k+3) * u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) + u (i+k)) =
                                 (u (j+k+3) * u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) + u (j+k)) := by
          rw [ih (k+3) (by omega), ih (k+2) (by omega), ih (k+1) (by omega), ih k (by omega)]
          rfl
        have h_rhs_eq : ((u (i+k+3) + u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) * u (i+k)) : ℝ) / (u (i+k+3) * u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) + u (i+k)) =
                        ((u (j+k+3) + u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) * u (j+k)) : ℝ) / (u (j+k+3) * u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) + u (j+k)) := by
          rw [h_rhs_eq_int, h_rhs_eq_denom_int]
          rfl
        calc
          (u (i+k+4) : ℝ) = ((u (i+k+3) + u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) * u (i+k)) : ℝ) / (u (i+k+3) * u (i+k+2) + u (i+k+1) + u (i+k)) := h_eq_i
          _ = ((u (j+k+3) + u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) * u (j+k)) : ℝ) / (u (j+k+3) * u (j+k+2) + u (j+k+1) + u (j+k)) := h_rhs_eq
          _ = (u (j+k+4) : ℝ) := by rw [← h_eq_j]; rfl
        exact_mod_cast this
  use i, (j - i)
  have h_pos : j - i > 0 := by omega
  constructor
  · exact h_pos
  · intro n hn
    have h_eq_n := h_periodic (n - i)
    have h_add : i + (n - i) = n := by omega
    have h_add_j : j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) := by omega
    rw [h_add] at h_eq_n
    rw [h_add_j] at h_eq_n
    exact id (Eq.symm h_eq_n)
